what: the four floor edges of a rectangular pocket rounded r2 (concave), the pocket's vertical corners left sharp
method: plate 60x40x10 with the pocket 30x20x5 (x 15..45, y 10..30, floor z = 5, sharp vertical corners): V0 = 24000 - 3000 = 21000. Each concave floor edge gains the spandrel (1-pi/4) r^2 = 0.858407 along its whole length (30, 30, 20, 20: 100); at each sharp vertical corner the two rounds run into each other (a mitre), their spandrel prisms overlapping in int_0^r L(u)^2 du, L(u) = r - sqrt(r^2-(r-u)^2), = r^3 (5/3 - pi/2) = 0.766963.
